The resulting merged map is stored on the `Settings` struct.

At query time, **`Settings::half_life`** (`src/memory/mod.rs`, lines 221–223) is the method callers use — it does a simple lookup into that pre-merged map, returning `0.0` if the kind is somehow absent (meaning no decay).
